test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: An article costing Rs. 200 is sold at a loss of 10%. Find the selling price.
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = Rs. 200

Loss = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = CP × (1 − Loss%)

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = 200 × (1 − 10/100)

⇒ SP = 200 × (1 − 0.1)

⇒ SP = 200 × 0.9

⇒ SP = Rs. 180

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 180.**
